"use strict";
self["rspackHotUpdate"]("main", {},function(__webpack_require__) {
// webpack/runtime/ensure_async_block
(() => {

__webpack_require__.eb = (function(chunks, rows) {
  var previous = "";
  chunks = chunks.map(function(row) {
    return typeof row === "number" ? row : (previous = previous.slice(0, row[0]) + row[1]);
  });
  var blocks = Object.create(null);
  previous = "";
  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    previous = previous.slice(0, row[0]) + row[1];
    blocks[previous] = [row[2], row[3]];
  });
  var ensureBlock = function(blockId, ensureChunk) {
    var block = blocks[blockId];
    if (!block) return Promise.reject(new Error("Missing async block " + blockId));
    return Promise.all(block[0].map(function(chunkId) {
      return ensureChunk(chunks[chunkId], block[1] || undefined);
    }));
  };
  ensureBlock.has = function(blockId) { return blocks[blockId] !== undefined; };
  return ensureBlock;
})([[0,"feature_js"],[10,"_lazy-compilation-proxy"],[0,"other_js"],[0,"shared"]], [[0,"<TEST_TOOLS_ROOT>/dist/helper/hot-update/loader.js!<TEST_ROOT>/js/temp/hot-snapshot/hotSnapshotCases-hotCases/lazy-compilation/stable-async-map/index.js|dep=esm|./feature|loc=6:18-37",[1],null],[0,"<TEST_TOOLS_ROOT>/dist/helper/hot-update/loader.js!<TEST_ROOT>/js/temp/hot-snapshot/hotSnapshotCases-hotCases/lazy-compilation/stable-async-map/infrastructure.js|dep=esm|./other|loc=1:32-49",[3,2],null],[0,"lazy-compilation-proxy|<TEST_TOOLS_ROOT>/dist/helper/hot-update/loader.js!<TEST_ROOT>/js/temp/hot-snapshot/hotSnapshotCases-hotCases/lazy-compilation/stable-async-map/feature.js|dep=",[3,0],null]]);
